responsibility: Defines the AVR target’s compile-time machine description interface and ABI macros used by GCC core code and generated backend sources. It declares address-space identifiers and layout, target capability macros derived from the selected architecture, fundamental type sizes and alignments, register file properties, calling-convention and stack-frame macros, assembler-output conventions, driver spec hooks, and the AVR-specific `machine_function` structure that stores per-function backend state such as ISR attributes and gasisr decisions.
same_name_distinction: This is the AVR target interface/header file: unlike avr.cc it does not implement hooks, unlike avr.md it does not encode RTL instruction patterns, and unlike avr.opt it does not declare command-line switches; instead it supplies the macros, enums, declarations, and per-function data structures those other same-stem files use.
